reason: I've drunk the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it hits me, so I'm not committing 649 CZK plus shipping to twelve cans of something I've never tasted. I'd maybe grab a free can at a launch event, but I wouldn't order a pack blind.
objection: The label is in English, so is this even a Czech product? And 80 mg of caffeine from yerba mate with no sugar, I'm not sure it will actually wake me up like my usual drink does, and 54 CZK a can is more than I pay now.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a free can first and finding it gives me the same kick as my usual drink, then being able to buy a few cans on Rohlík instead of a 12-pack.
